axes.S2: +y in the ring frame through Q=(-34,0,0) (P at rest = baseline P in y,z, x moved 34 mm toward the body); AK70 #2, direct
axes.S3: along the arm, XM540 in a sleeve on the S2 bracket; R = Rx(a) Ry(-t2) Rz(t3), d = (-sin t2, -cos t2 sin a, cos t2 cos a)

P.rel_back: P at rest is 74 mm behind the back (baseline 108)
P.rel_baseline_P: dx = -34 mm (toward the body), dy = dz = 0 at rest; P now moves on a circle of radius 120 about C

mass_g.note: bought here = 2 AK70 1242 + XM540 165 + balls 12; bearing races are printed PA-CF, vendor ring would add ~0.4-0.6 kg (PLACEHOLDER)

torque.formula: M = g [ m_stage RHO + m_arm (RHO + cg) + m_pl (RHO + L) ], m_stage 1.136 kg, m_arm 1.489 kg, cg 0.249 m, payload 0.5 kg at 0.575 m, RHO 0.120 m (arm horizontal, ring at +-90 deg)
torque.S2: unchanged: 6.49 N.m worst unbalanced (SF 1.28), 2.89 N.m with the zero-length balancer (SF 2.87); S1 now carries gravity (baseline S1 had none), the 3:1 belt is what makes it SF >= 2
torque.backlash: belt stage: assume 0.1 deg at the ring (unverified); tip error 575 mm * 0.1 deg = 1.0 mm

ring_bearing.formula: M = S2 reaction 6.49 + g m_tot x_lever (m_tot 3.12 kg, lever 0.16 m)
ring_bearing.formula_ball: F = 2M/(n R) + 2 g m/n, n 40 balls D4, R 0.09 m
ring_bearing.allowable_N: 80 per D4 ball printed race (UNVERIFIED), SF 5.6
ring_bearing.tilt_tip: radial clearance 0.1 mm / R 90 mm = 1.1 mrad -> 0.64 mm at the 575 mm tip

wing_load.formula: sqrt(M_S1^2 + M_ring^2): S1 gravity torque is reacted in the plate plane (new) and the ring tilt moment as before
